Scenic views of beaches, historic landmarks, wildlife, and coastal scenery

services.name: Beach Cruiser Helicopter Tour
services.desc: The Beach Cruiser Tour takes you on a thrilling flight over the stunning, sandy shores of Hilton Head Island. Departing from Hilton Head Airport, we head east, flying right over the island’s most popular beaches! You’ll enjoy stunning views of Folly Field Beach, Broad Creek, and Port Royal Sound along the way. This flight offers breathtaking panoramic views of the island, from the northern shores to the southern tip. Like the impressive vacation destination we call home, Hilton Head Helicopter Tours curates incredible experiences for our guests. Let us elevate your Hilton Head journey today! Tours range from short introductory flights to longer excursions over Hilton Head Island, Bluffton, and nearby islands. Custom and special event flights are available, including proposals, photo flights, and gender reveals.
